### What is Everstake's background and structure?
Everstake was founded in 2018 by Sergii Vasylchuk and a team of engineers, with the mission to bridge the gap between traditional and decentralized finance by making institutional-grade staking accessible. To date, over 75% of the company consists of engineers and technical specialists.1 (https://everstake.com/company/about) Its legal entity is Everstake Validation Services LLC, a Cayman Islands limited liability company registered in George Town, Grand Cayman.7 (https://everstake.com/terms-of-use) Everstake describes itself as a global provider.1 (https://everstake.com/company/about)
Leadership titles change over time and the company page may lag: as of a June 2025 Everstake announcement (https://everstake.com/resources/blog/david-kinitsky-joins-everstake-as-ceo), David Kinitsky is CCDO and Sergii Vasylchuk is CEO & President.
